# ai_dotfiles — onboarding

## 1. Goal

**What:** The single source of the owner's global AI-CLI setup on macOS: one rules file, per-CLI settings keys, shared MCP servers, 36 skills and two hooked skills (daily-log, worktree-guard), applied to Claude Code, Codex CLI, Pi and Antigravity so every CLI behaves the same way in every project.

**How:** `config/ai-clis.json` says which CLIs are on and where each reads things. `ai-dotfiles install` runs five Python steps that link what is read-only (the rules file, every skill folder, two commands, Pi's extension) and merge what a CLI writes back (settings keys, hook entries; MCP servers through `<cli> mcp add`). Every write is validated first, backed up, atomic, and rolled back on failure. Hooks go through one adapter, `scripts/agent_hooks.py`, that turns each CLI's hook JSON into one `Event` and back; Pi, which has no hook files, gets `scripts/agent_hooks.ts` as its extension. `ai-dotfiles check` compares the live state with the repo, CI runs the unittest suites and shellcheck on every push, and a weekly GitHub Action mirrors each CLI's docs and reports upstream skill changes in a pull request.

## 2. System design

**Shape:** one monolith of scripts and config, with no frontend or API: a CLI (`ai-dotfiles`, incl. `worktree`), a second command (`daily-log`), hook scripts behind one adapter, a Pi extension and two GitHub Actions workflows.

### Tech stack

| Layer | Technology | Version | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| Language | Python, standard library only | 3.11+; CI runs 3.12 | `scripts/install.sh:80`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml:35` |
| Language | Bash | — | `scripts/*.sh`, `scripts/ai-dotfiles` |
| Language | TypeScript, one file, no build (Pi's extension) | — | `scripts/agent_hooks.ts` |
| Config | JSON for the desired state, Markdown for rules and skills | — | `config/`, `skills/` |
| Tests | unittest, against a temporary `HOME` | — | `scripts/tests/`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml:38` |
| Lint | shellcheck (warning level); pyright paths | — | `.github/workflows/ci.yml:23`, `pyrightconfig.json` |
| CI | GitHub Actions: tests and lint on push; Monday docs sync | — | `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/sync-cli-docs.yml` |
| Targets | Claude Code, Codex CLI, Pi, Antigravity | — | `config/ai-clis.json` |

### Folder structure

```text
ai_dotfiles/
├── AGENTS.md                 ★ maintainer rules and the verify commands
├── config/
│   ├── ai-clis.json          ★ which CLIs are on, where each reads
│   ├── global-agents.md      the one global rule file, linked into every CLI
│   ├── cli-settings.json     per-CLI settings keys: enforce and default
│   ├── mcp-servers.json      shared MCP servers (context7)
│   └── upstream-docs.json    the docs sources mirrored weekly
├── skills/                   36 skill folders, linked into every CLI

├── scripts/

│   ├── agent_hooks.py        ★ every CLI's hook format behind one Event API
│   ├── agent_hooks.ts        Pi's extension: forwards Pi events to both hooks
│   ├── install.sh            the five steps; uninstall.sh reverses them
│   ├── healthcheck.sh        the live-state check
│   ├── install/              one step per source; installer.py writes safely
│   ├── upstream/             the weekly docs mirror and its PR report
│   └── tests/                unittest suites, one per script; fixtures/
├── docs/
│   ├── how-it-works.md       ★ the mechanism and each CLI's paths
│   ├── onboarding.md         this report, written by /onboard
│   └── upstream/             machine-written docs mirror and skill catalogs
├── reference/                local only (.git/info/exclude): upstream checkouts
└── .github/workflows/        ci.yml (tests, shellcheck); sync-cli-docs.yml
```

### Workflows

#### install — `ai-dotfiles install` (and `check`, CI)

```text
desired state ──▶ installer ──▶ global files
                      ├──▶ hook files
                      └──mcp add──▶ MCP registry
push ──▶ CI job ──▶ unit tests, shellcheck
ai-dotfiles check ──▶ healthcheck ──▶ dry-run install (expect 0 changes)
```

- desired state (repo): which CLIs are on and where each reads things, incl. optional `hooks` and `extensions` paths — `config/ai-clis.json:4`, `scripts/install/installer.py:27`
- installer (repo): `install.sh` checks the registry, then runs one step per source; `update` fast-forwards `main` first — `scripts/ai-dotfiles:33`, `scripts/install.sh:86`, `:94`, `:98`, `:101`, `:104`, `:107`
- global files (home): links to the rules file, each skill, `~/.local/bin/{ai-dotfiles,daily-log}` and Pi's `ai-dotfiles-hooks.ts` (the old daily-log extension is removed); settings keys merged; writes backed up, atomic, rolled back — `scripts/install/skills.py:31`, `:36`, `scripts/install/settings.py:150`, `scripts/install/installer.py:136`
- hook files (home): per feature (daily-log, worktree-guard) one entry per native event, from `agent_hooks.native_events`; found again by the script path in the command, which ends in `|| true` — `scripts/install/hooks.py:41`, `:68`, `:75`, `:112`, `:149`, `scripts/agent_hooks.py:246`
- MCP registry (CLIs): `<cli> mcp add` for each missing server; Antigravity's file merged; never removed — `scripts/install/mcp.py:62`, `:99`
- CI job (GitHub): shellcheck and the tests on Python 3.12 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml:23`, `:38`
- healthcheck (repo): dry-run install, `mcp list`, machine-path scan, tests — `scripts/healthcheck.sh:22`, `:54`, `:72`, `:80`

#### worktree-guard — a second session edits a worktree another owns

```text
edit/shell call ──▶ agent_hooks ──▶ guard decide ──▶ claim
                                         └─busy──▶ clash ──▶ linked worktree
                                                     └──▶ Deny or Rewrite
```

- edit/shell call (CLIs): `PreToolUse` on edits and shell (Antigravity also reads); Pi's `tool_call` — `scripts/install/hooks.py:41`, `scripts/agent_hooks.ts:37`
- agent_hooks (repo): reads the CLI's JSON into an `Event` (tool → action), loads the session's state, renders the reply in that CLI's shape, fails open — `scripts/agent_hooks.py:103`, `:215`, `:124`, `:232`
- guard decide (repo): the worktrees the call touches (file paths, `apply_patch` headers, git commands that change the tree); refuses `release`/`share` from an agent — `skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py:474`, `:253`, `:208`
- claim (home): first edit owns the worktree under a file lock; owner alive by pid, subagents share it; freed at `SessionEnd` — `skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py:365`, `:384`
- clash (repo): makes `.claude/worktrees/<cli>-<id>` on `agent/<cli>-<id>` from the busy head, records metadata — `skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py:433`, `:405`
- linked worktree (outside): the session's new home; finished with `ai-dotfiles worktree done`, removed by the person with `rm` after an `archive/` tag — `skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py:619`, `:634`, `scripts/ai-dotfiles:37`
- Deny or Rewrite (CLIs): Claude Code is told to call `EnterWorktree`; Codex, Pi, Antigravity get their paths and `cd` rewritten — `skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py:305`, `:415`

#### daily-log nudge — an edit, then the end of a turn

```text
edit ──▶ hook tool ──▶ session state ──▶ hook stop ──▶ nudge
                                                        └──▶ daily-log add
                                                               └──▶ journal
```

- edit (CLIs): `PostToolUse` on edit tools; Pi's `tool_result` — `scripts/agent_hooks.ts:45`
- hook tool (repo): counts the call when its action is an edit — `skills/daily-log/scripts/daily_log.py:252`
- session state (home): `edits`, `nudges`, `logged` per session in `~/.local/state/ai-dotfiles/daily-log/`, pruned after 7 days — `skills/daily-log/scripts/daily_log.py:243`, `scripts/agent_hooks.py:206`
- hook stop (repo): nudges once per new batch of edits, at most twice, never in its own continuation (remembered for Pi and Antigravity) — `skills/daily-log/scripts/daily_log.py:258`, `scripts/agent_hooks.py:223`
- nudge (CLIs): a `Continue` rendered per CLI; Pi's `agent_before_settle` — `skills/daily-log/scripts/daily_log.py:47`, `scripts/agent_hooks.py:162`, `scripts/agent_hooks.ts:53`
- daily-log add (repo): merges a `- [X] label` entry into today's block; `--session` marks the session logged — `skills/daily-log/scripts/daily_log.py:186`, `:118`, `:246`
- journal (outside): `<root>/<yyyy>/<Mon>/week-<i>`, grammar in `LOG-FORMAT.md` — `skills/daily-log/scripts/daily_log.py:62`

#### weekly sync — Monday cron in `sync-cli-docs.yml`

```text
cron ──▶ sync job ──▶ docs mirror ──▶ mirror files ──▶ upstream report ──▶ PR
                      ▲ pages                          ▲ pinned files
                      docs sites                       GitHub API
```

- cron (GitHub): Monday 01:00 UTC, or on demand — `.github/workflows/sync-cli-docs.yml:6`
- sync job (GitHub): runs the mirror, the catalog update, then the report — `.github/workflows/sync-cli-docs.yml:46`, `:59`
- docs mirror (repo): one fetcher per source kind; a source below its page floor or with an error keeps the previous copy — `scripts/upstream/sync-upstream.py:373`, `:432`, `:505`
- docs sites (outside): the four CLIs' docs, Google's and Meta's guides — `config/upstream-docs.json`
- mirror files (repo): `docs/upstream/<source>/` with `MIRROR-INDEX.*` — `scripts/upstream/sync-upstream.py:407`
- upstream report (repo): diffs pinned skills against upstream; writes the PR body — `scripts/upstream/report-upstream.py:159`, `:91`
- GitHub API (outside): pinned files and each collection's tree — `scripts/upstream/report-upstream.py:91`, `:102`
- PR (GitHub): `upstream-sync` force-pushed, the PR opened or edited — `.github/workflows/sync-cli-docs.yml:67`, `:72`

## 3. Conventions

- Files: Python modules and tests in snake_case, one `test_<script>.py` per script; shell scripts and config files in kebab-case; every skill is a folder with a `SKILL.md`; a hooked skill keeps its script in `skills/<name>/scripts/`.
- Code: direct imports, no injection; hook scripts import `agent_hooks` from the repo's `scripts/` by path and supply only `decide(event, state)` (`skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py:45`). Install steps plan `(path, before, after)` changes, `installer.show`, then `installer.apply` (`scripts/install/hooks.py:223`). Subprocesses run synchronously.
- Errors: shell under `set -euo pipefail` (`scripts/install.sh:24`); install steps raise `ValueError` naming the path and refuse to guess (`scripts/install/hooks.py:146`). Hooks are the opposite: always exit 0, never print to stderr, fail open (`scripts/agent_hooks.py:232`, `skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py:778`, `scripts/agent_hooks.ts:25`); the guard says when an edit went unprotected.
- Tests: load each script by path, run against a temporary `HOME` and state folder (`scripts/tests/support.py:11`); worktree-guard's tests use real temporary git repos.
- Git: conventional-commit subjects with a scope (`feat(worktree-guard): …`, `refactor(hooks): …`); feature branches `feat/<name>` merged locally with merge commits; older work squash-merged as PRs ending in `(#N)`. `main` is the only long-lived branch, plus `upstream-sync`, force-pushed weekly.

## 4. Common tasks

- Test: `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests`
- Lint: `shellcheck scripts/*.sh scripts/ai-dotfiles`
- Preview an install: `bash scripts/install.sh --dry-run` (zero changes on a configured Mac)
- Check the live state: `bash scripts/healthcheck.sh`, or `ai-dotfiles check`
- Install, update, uninstall: `ai-dotfiles install`, `ai-dotfiles update`, `ai-dotfiles uninstall`
- One step: `python3 scripts/install/<step>.py --dry-run`, `--uninstall`, `--target <cli>`
- Agents' worktrees: `ai-dotfiles worktree list | done | rm | prune | release | share`
- Log work: `daily-log add --done "<label>" "<line>"`; `daily-log show`, `daily-log path`

## 5. Where to look

| I want to… | Look at… |
|---|---|
| switch a CLI on or off, or change where it reads | `config/ai-clis.json` |
| change a global rule | `config/global-agents.md` |
| enforce or default a CLI setting | `config/cli-settings.json`, then `scripts/install/settings.py` |
| add an MCP server | `config/mcp-servers.json` |
| add or update a skill | `skills/<name>/`, `skills/skills.lock`, `skills/which-skill/SKILL.md` |
| change how a step writes files | `scripts/install/installer.py` |
| support a new CLI's hooks, or a tool name | `TOOLS`, `MATCHERS`, `read()`, `render()` in `scripts/agent_hooks.py` |
| add a hooked skill | a `Feature` in `scripts/install/hooks.py`, a handler in `scripts/agent_hooks.ts` |
| change when sessions clash or how they move | `decide()`, `clash()`, `steer()` in `skills/worktree-guard/scripts/worktree_guard.py` |
| why worktree-guard is built this way | git history: `git log --oneline -- .scratch/worktree-guard` (decisions, prior art, CLI hook research) |
| change the day pass's evidence or its writing session | `render_day()` and `CLAUDE_ARGS` in `skills/daily-log/scripts/day_pass.py` |
| change the journal grammar | `skills/daily-log/LOG-FORMAT.md`, then `add_entry()` |
| add or change a docs source | `config/upstream-docs.json`, `scripts/upstream/sync-upstream.py`, the `collect-docs` skill |
| change the weekly PR report | `scripts/upstream/report-upstream.py`, `.github/workflows/sync-cli-docs.yml` |
| see why a check fails | `scripts/healthcheck.sh` |
